fusions.name: Counter-Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Chummed Water
fusions.desc: Sprays poison in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage with a 70% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%, and your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Venom Siphon
fusions.desc: Removes 2 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Bitter Meal
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. You carry 10% poison resistance.
